# intenter status

Show the daemon, integration and recent activity

One screen with the daemon's version, uptime, endpoint and service mode, the
Claude Code integration state, approval counts by state, and how many
decisions of each kind were made in the last 24 hours. For a failing
installation use `intenter doctor`, which says what to fix.

## Usage

```text
intenter status
```

## Examples

```console
intenter status
intenter status --json
```
